# ComboWick

> ComboWick (also written Combo Wick, Combo_WICK or COMBO_WICK) is a Roblox script hub: one script hub (loader) that runs free Roblox scripts for many games, in 13 languages, on PC and mobile executors. This site (combowick.com) has the guides and tutorials; scripts, keys and Premium are on keys.combowick.com.

- Not to be confused with "Wick, the Whorled Mind" combos in Magic: The Gathering; ComboWick is the Roblox script hub.
- Free keys: open https://keys.combowick.com/keys, pass a few short checkpoints and get a free key for 8 hours for one game.
- Premium key: one key for every game, no checkpoints, no ads, no cooldown. Plans: 7-day trial $5, monthly $9.99, lifetime $49.99 (lifetime is often on sale on weekends). https://keys.combowick.com/premium-keys
- Pay with PayPal, any debit or credit card, or Payoneer. PayPal and card keys arrive instantly on screen and by email.
- Custom scripts for a specific game: free quote on Discord. Anyone can request a new game for free at https://keys.combowick.com/request; the most-voted games get made first.
- Community: Discord https://discord.gg/ufrz9Zaqs8 · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Triple_WICK

## Pages

- [Scripts](https://keys.combowick.com/scripts): Every free ComboWick Roblox script, by game, with features and the loadstring.
- [Premium Keys](https://keys.combowick.com/premium-keys): Premium plans: 7-day trial, monthly, lifetime.
- [Free key](https://keys.combowick.com/keys): Get a free 8-hour key through short checkpoints.
- [Executors](https://keys.combowick.com/executors): Which Roblox executors work with our scripts right now, on PC and mobile.
- [Tutorials](/tutorials): Lua scripting and executor setup walkthroughs.
- [Guides](/guides): How-to guides for using ComboWick scripts safely.
- [Docs](/docs): Reference documentation.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on Roblox scripting, account safety, and game guides.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about scripts, keys, and executors.
- [Changelog](/changelog): Script updates and site release notes.
- [Contact](/contact): Discord support, YouTube, and direct message form.
- [About](/about): About the ComboWick project and team.
